description: Pair match: do two reports describe the same problem? Levels are outcomes, so route on round(score).
instructions: Do `report_a` and `report_b` describe the same problem or request?
criteria: The two reports describe different problems or requests
They might describe the same problem, but the reports leave it unclear
They describe the same problem or request, so fixing one would close the other
output: Router decision: level 2 proposes linking the new item to the older one (a person or the orchestrator confirms); level 1 adds a `possible duplicate` note; level 0 does nothing.
